login.title: Log in
login.description: Welcome back! Log in to continue to your library.
login.rememberMeHelp: Stay logged in on this device for up to 30 days. Leave unchecked on shared computers.

register.title: Create an account
register.description: Start tracking what you read, rate books and join the conversation.

usernameHelper: {{usernameMin}}–{{usernameMax}} characters: letters, numbers, dots, dashes and underscores.

validation.usernamePattern: Username can only contain letters, numbers, dots, dashes and underscores.
validation.passwordMaxBytes: Password must be at most {{passwordMaxBytes}} bytes long.
validation.passwordMissing: Password doesn't meet all the requirements above.

avatar.title: Profile picture
avatar.description: Shown in the menu and next to your reviews and comments.
avatar.helper: JPG, PNG or WebP. It is cropped to a square from the centre and resized to {{avatarSizePx}}×{{avatarSizePx}} px; at most {{avatarMaxMb}} MB after resizing.
avatar.removedNote: Your picture will be removed when you save.

validation.type: Choose a JPG, PNG or WebP image.
validation.size: The picture must be at most {{avatarMaxMb}} MB.
validation.unreadable: This image couldn't be read. Try another file.

ban.title: Ban {{username}}
ban.description: The user is logged out everywhere and can't log in until the ban ends. They see the reason when they try.
ban.durationHelper: Pick how long the ban lasts. You can lift it at any time.
ban.reasonHelper: Up to {{banReasonMax}} characters. The user sees this text.

validation.duration: Choose a duration of 1 to {{banDaysMax}} days, or permanent.
